note: SNG-172. HOW a craft is POWERED — a separate axis from powerSystem, which is the ACCESS taxonomy (which reach granted it) and is load-bearing in progression.js. Never conflate them.
canonAmendment: RATIFIED by Erik 2026-07-19. The founding claim 'every craft in this world is nanite-mediated' is NO LONGER UNIVERSAL. Some power is natural — body, breath, growth, grief, craft-of-hand — and is not lattice-mediated at all. ⛔ SUPERSEDED IN PART, 2026-08-08 (SNG-376/377/378): lattice and nanite are SEPARATE (different builders, different eras); `natural` split into `body` and `metaphysical`, which want different ground; `veil` added as a source powered by an ABSENCE. ⚠️ THE REBASE BELOW IS NOT A RENAME — seraphic, abyssal and numinous changed PRIMARY on Erik's rulings, and god_named and bargainers were authored for the first time. 26/26 traditions now carry a mix.
ruling_natural_benefits: Erik 2026-07-19: natural craft BENEFITS from a thin lattice, not merely goes unpenalised. The Quickwood is not the Returned's tolerable ground — it is their BEST ground. This is what makes them equal rather than compensated.

sources.precursor: The Precursor lattice — the built substrate that reads structured will. Alien, ancient, still obeying instructions nobody living gave it. Two-sided band {0.90, 0.20}: dense ground helps until it interferes. ⚠️ It is WAR INFRASTRUCTURE (SNG-377): built by one side of a conflict that has not ended.
sources.nanite: ⛔ SEPARATE FROM THE LATTICE (Erik 2026-08-08). Machinery deployed BEFORE the Transition, still running to its old specification — human-made, younger than the Precursors. It goes where its makers put it and where people carry it, so it answers to CONDITION AND SUPPLY, not to ground: no band, no floor. It fails by breaking, and breakage is mechanical and repairable.
sources.wild: Ungoverned nanites — the Wild Half's tangled current. Widens BOTH crit bands (SNG-140). Band {0.32, 0.34}; thrives in the unreached gaps.
sources.metaphysical: Mind reaching past matter, opened by the Transition. Band {0.15, 0.22} — ⚠️ it WANTS THIN GROUND: a dense lattice is apparatus standing between the practitioner and the thing itself. The OLDEST way, and the one the lattice was built to replace. (Was `inherent`.)
sources.body: Body, skill, stone, edge, breath, years. Reaches for nothing and needs nothing, so nothing can be taken from it: ⛔ a FLOOR, flat at every density, and the floor is a STATED fact rather than the absence of a band (SNG-380). 'The pure never loses because it never leaned on anything.' Augmented craft in wrong ground degrades TOWARD its pure form rather than failing. (Was `material`.)
sources.veil: ⛔ POWERED BY AN ABSENCE, NOT A SUBSTANCE. The Veil is a defensive work; thinning it opens a breach. Band {0.10, 0.20} — the MIRROR of precursor, because thinning one strengthens the other. ⚠️ Rare by design: most traditions must not have this, and its scarcity is characterisation.
sources.combination: Two or more sources at once, scaled by mix — ⛔ NEVER rounded to the dominant one. Erik's case: nanite moves the cup, metaphysics aims it, and thin ground helps one half while hurting the other IN THE SAME ACTION.

method: Classified against REGION SUBSTRATE DENSITY as evidence, with the craft's own description as the judgement. The prediction was recorded in SNG-172 §4 BEFORE the pass: 'most abilities in low-density traditions should come out natural or wild; if the pass produces a lattice-dominant Rootkin, the pass is wrong.' It held — see validation.

enginewright.why: Enginecraft IS the lattice running. Densest region in the world (0.98).

lattice.why: Latticework is built INTO the substrate; the city and the lattice are one structure (0.94).

seraphic.why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-08: 'the Seraphs and Abyssals are mostly nanite.' The Orders' craft is pre-Transition machinery, kept and inherited; the PRECURSOR share is devotional as much as technical — they idealise the builders and have learned a little of the lattice directly. Their faith is the axis; their craft is nanite.

blazeborn.why: Radiance burns on lattice, not on fuel (0.86).

figurist.why: Formcraft works in pattern and idea — it needs a medium to impose them on (0.85).

hourkeeper.why: Duration is tended, not felt. Hourcraft reaches into the substrate to hold time still (0.84).

numinous.why: ⛔ REVERTED 2026-08-08, one hour after I reclassified it veil-primary. ERIK: 'are you saying that a Numinous likes a thick boundary?' No — and my sentence contradicted the veil band I had authored the same hour ('a dense lattice closes the way'). THREE pieces of evidence I had and did not check: (1) the_substrate.json theTradeoff lists the Numinous among theContinuous — 'helpless where the lattice is gone'; (2) their region density is 0.82, dense; (3) NINE of their ten abilities are about MEANING-density, not a membrane — numen_sense reads 'where MEANING runs dense', thin_place 'where SIGNIFICANCE runs dense'. ⚠️ Their aesthetic says 'thinning veils' as MYSTIC IDIOM and I read it as the cosmological Veil. Same error as reading a targeting constraint as a fuel source: a phrase in one register taken as a claim in another. The 0.05 veil share is the Beyond-Facing school only (SNG-378), which is rare and disputed among them.

churnfolk.why: Wildcraft is the named case. Constant productive disorder is what wild current DOES.

abyssal.why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-08: mostly nanite, like the Seraphs — the two are the same craft pointed at opposite devotions. The WILD share is the Deep Below's untended field. The VEIL share is what makes them Abyssal: they alone reach for what is on the far side, and it reaches back.

unmaker.why: Ruinwork ends things well — it works with what is already coming apart (0.42).

veilwright.why: Falsecraft needs a medium to carry a false thing. Mid-high density (0.66) and it uses every bit.

umbral.why: Umbracraft sees by other means — partly instrument, partly trained sense (0.58).

cogitant.why: ERIK'S WORKED EXAMPLE: nanite to move matter with a mind, natural for the mind itself. Telekinesis borrows the lattice; the thought that aims it does not.

syllogist.why: Reason is natural; making a proof BIND is not (0.60).

horizon.why: Walking is natural. Folding the distance you walk is not (0.44).

wright.why: Makecraft is craft-of-hand that reaches for the lattice when the hand is not enough (0.52).

rootkin.why: Vivimancy GROWS. The Rootkin completed the Transition and released the lattice; the green current replaced it. Thinnest region in the world (0.12) and their best ground.

marcher.why: The Edge is skill at arms in a body. Nothing to borrow (0.20).

somatic.why: Soma is the perfected body. Somatic discipline is a retuning AWAY from the lattice (0.22).

mason.why: Thingcraft holds that only what can be touched is real — weight that stands without the lattice (0.30).

ashwarden.why: Palework tends endings. What tends endings does not hold a charge (0.32).

verist.why: Verity is speech and refusal. Saying what is so costs nothing but the saying (0.46).

threnodist.why: Pathos holds that feeling is the only true instrument. Feeling is not lattice-mediated (0.48).

stillhold.why: Stillcraft is a vow kept. The Stillhold gave the lattice up with the war.

god_named.why: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-08: 'the God-Named use nanites from pre-transition mostly; some may have learned to harness wild nanites or use some precursor lattice.' ⚠️ AND THE HOME-GROUND EFFECT IS PHYSICAL, NOT BELIEF: their own people carry a store of nanites, so a bearer is strongest among them — power that travels with a population rather than sitting in terrain.

bargainers.why: A table, a ledger, and terms named exactly — almost entirely unaugmented craft. The PRECURSOR share is the Bound Ledger, terms written into something that does not forget. The VEIL share is Far Terms, which nobody advertises.

perAbilityOverrides.note: Empty by design. A tradition-level default plus explicit deviations is far less content than 285 authored fields, and a deviation is the interesting fact. Add here only where an ability genuinely departs from its tradition's mix.

_rebase: SNG-378: lattice→precursor · natural→body · inherent→metaphysical · material→body. ⛔ Anything keying on the string 'lattice', 'natural', 'inherent' or 'material' is now keying on nothing — that is how the school band table died silently. Bands live in the_substrate.json → sourceBands.
